_comment: Household budget targets. Edited by the household's humans together, not by an agent acting alone. Dollar figures are monthly unless noted. Copy to config/budget.json and edit; the real file is gitignored.

income.source: Employer name as it appears on the paycheck transaction
income._note: Placeholders throughout: set your real cadence, amount, and a recent payday so the engine can project the next one.

accounts._note: The engine finds this by name match. Safe-to-Spend is computed against this balance only.
accounts._exclude_note: Matched by name substring, never counted in reachable money or runway. Use this to keep separate-purpose accounts out of the household number.

fixed_monthly._comment: Contractual. The engine subtracts any of these still due before the next payday. All values here are placeholders: replace with your real bills.

essentials_monthly._comment: Real needs. The engine reserves the unspent remainder of these for the rest of the period, so Safe-to-Spend never eats the grocery money.

transfer_overrides._comment: Zelle/transfer payments that are really spending, matched by substring against the transaction's plaidName or merchant. Without these, payments to people are invisible. Example: a house cleaner paid by Zelle.

discretionary_monthly._comment: What Safe-to-Spend is drawn from. Spending here is a choice.

category_map._comment: Finance-source category name -> which bucket it counts against.

thresholds._comment: Drives the green/amber/red status on the dashboard and the morning message.

notify._note: Message your bot once, then add your numeric chat id here. One id per household member who should get the briefs.

alerts._comment: Push alerts between quiet hours. Sent by scripts/alerts.py via the watch job.
